title: Computational Repurposing of FDA-Approved Drugs as Candidate MMP2 Inhibitors with Putative MMP3 Cross-Activity.
authors: Zekri, Saad; Ait Lahcen, Nouhaila; Liman, Wissal; Bianchini, Francesca; Oubahmane, Mehdi; Hdoufane, Ismail; Cherqaoui, Driss
one_liner_zh: 该文利用药效团筛选、分子对接和MD模拟对FDA药物库进行MMP2/MMP3抑制剂的计算机重定位，虽以蛋白为对象并采用计算模拟，但属工程化应用且非蛋白结构核心建模创新。
abstract: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a progressive interstitial lung disease characterized by excessive extracellular matrix remodeling and limited therapeutic options. Matrix metalloproteinase-2 is involved in extracellular matrix degradation and tissue remodeling, making it a relevant target for antifibrotic drug discovery. In this study, an MMP2-focused ligand-based pharmacophore model was developed and was applied to screen a curated FDA-approved drug library, leading to the identification of 83 pharmacophore-matching compounds. These compounds were subsequently prioritized through molecular docking against the catalytic site of MMP2, and the five best candidates were further evaluated by molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Because of the biological relevance of MMP3 in pulmonary fibrosis, these five selected compounds were also profiled against MMP3 as a secondary target. Among them, Regorafenib (S1178) and Capmatinib (S2788) showed the most favorable cross-target profiles and were further supported by MD analysis. From these findings, S1178 and S2788 were proposed as promising MMP2-prioritized compounds with potential MMP3 cross-activity, warranting further experimental validation as candidate antifibrotic MMP modulators.
abstract_zh: 特发性肺纤维化（IPF）是一种进行性间质性肺疾病，其特征为细胞外基质过度重塑，且治疗选择有限。基质金属蛋白酶-2参与细胞外基质降解和组织重塑，使其成为抗纤维化药物发现的相关靶点。在本研究中，开发了一种基于配体的MMP2聚焦药效团模型，并将其应用于筛选精选的FDA批准药物库，从而鉴定出83种与药效团匹配的化合物。这些化合物随后通过针对MMP2催化位点的分子对接进行优先级排序，排名前五的候选化合物进一步通过分子动力学（MD）模拟评估。鉴于MMP3在肺纤维化中的生物学相关性，这五种选定的化合物也作为次要靶点对MMP3进行了分析。其中，瑞戈非尼（S1178）和卡马替尼（S2788）显示出最有利的交叉靶点特征，并得到MD分析的进一步支持。基于这些发现，S1178和S2788被提出作为具有潜在MMP3交叉活性的有前景的MMP2优先化合物，值得进一步实验验证，作为候选抗纤维化MMP调节剂。
